about: Candidate product photography sourced via Kimi (Sep 2026) from supplier, marketplace and editorial sites. None has a confirmed commercial licence: every image is imported as PERMISSION_PENDING and stays off the storefront until staff record permission for its source (Admin -> Image permissions). See PRODUCT_IMAGES.md.
